independence.method: All five final author files were fully read. Every exact prompt, answer, rubric, proof and stated source scope was separately assessed. The checker imports no author checker/helper and reads no author numerical output as an oracle.

Exact linear-system elimination for stock/bank replication and separate Arrow-price equations.
Statewise senior allocations followed by separately funded acquisition wallets and market-value wealth accounting.

prompt_solution_audit.recomputed_result: FCFF 18; supplied operating EV 180 plus surplus cash 10 less debt market value 50 yields equity 140.

prompt_solution_audit.independent_method: Reconstruct the covariance with two orthogonal unit-variance shocks, then compare polynomial coefficients for global positivity certificates.
prompt_solution_audit.recomputed_result: Variance .04w^2-.07w+.04; determinant 3/8000. Global minimum w=7/8, variance 3/320, mean 13/200. Mean at least .08 gives exactly [0,1/2], with minimum at 1/2 and variance 3/200.
prompt_solution_audit.assumptions_and_scope: The unconstrained square certificate is V=1/25(w-7/8)^2+3/320. On [0,1/2], V(w)-V(1/2)=(1/2-w)(1/20-w/25), strictly positive away from the right endpoint. A .09 mean target gives endpoint 1/4 and variance 1/40; .11 is infeasible. Conditional estimates are not known future risks or guarantees.

proof_audit.review: The positive geometric ratio is 17/18; an eight-term partial sum plus its exact remaining tail equals 200. Rolling one period and removing only date-one twelve gives 204. Equal growth and discount invalidate convergence. Passed.

D4/D6 correctly use replication under specified traded assets. O4 has a unique hedge at two extreme states but a ten-unit residual in the added state. The full positive-extension family and explicit endpoint arbitrages establish the open call-value interval, not a unique selected price. Passed.

Statewise senior/residual allocation and linear valuation conserve operating resources. The negotiated surplus ten accrues once to the acquiring investor; fair debt does not produce another surplus. All initial cash payers have sufficient distinct endowments. Passed.

Positive covariance determinant and complete-square identity prove the unconstrained result. Independent factor reconstruction yields the same coefficients. The exact feasible interval and positive difference factor establish the constrained global and unique optimum without relying on sampled weights. Passed.

The original hedge consumes the base premium. Segregated margin is returned once before the distinct bridge is repaid. Terminal seller cash is 1.04x-.2 in either state; positive slope yields necessary and sufficient x>=5/26 within supplied endowments. The x=0 negative full-payment projection signals infeasibility. Passed.

intervention_scopes: Receipts delayed while income is fixed; receivable and closing cash move in opposite directions.
Allowance zero versus six preserves cash; using net AR plus a second provision addition fails.
Changing physical probabilities changes the forecast, leaving traded state-price valuation fixed.
Move an actual five-unit disbursement across the deadline; unchanged promise/value cannot repair the earlier cutoff.
At growth equal to discount, positive discounted payments do not tend to zero; the perpetuity formula is unavailable.
A one-unit fee makes the previously impossible expected-wealth target feasible without hidden leverage.
Restoring the middle state destroys exact replication; endpoint prices admit explicit nonnegative nonzero zero-cost portfolios.
Debt face reduced to sixty leaves NPV unchanged but raises required own cash above the investor's five-unit endowment.
A nine-percent mean target restricts the optimum to one-quarter in asset one; eleven percent is impossible in this opportunity set.
The margin threshold fails just below the sharp extra charge and collapses to zero when bridge interest is removed.
At the minimum grant, an extra half-unit bridge is retained initially but creates a terminal one-fortieth deficit from interest.
Change the amount or delivery date of recovery: grant can become zero, infeasible, or one-half with no bridge.
